generate_build_files_for_platform: run generate_build_files.py with android bazel gn gyp or cmake to generate build system files
find_c_files_with_filter: create a function that recursively finds C source files matching a filter function in a directory
find_header_files_with_filter: create a function that recursively finds header files matching a filter function in a directory
extract_perlasm_from_cmake: parse a CMakeLists.txt file and extract all perlasm directives with input output and extra args
write_asm_files_from_perlasm: generate assembly files from perlasm directives for each supported OS and architecture combination
